title: EISCO Replacement Pestle, 3.85" Length - Mortar & Pestle Sets - Heavy Duty - Unglazed Grinding End - Excellent for Kitchen or Laboratory - Grinds Herbs & Spices - Pill Crusher
description:
About this item
REPLACEMENT PART || Replacement pestle, designed for use with Eisco Labs 50ml, 60ml or 70ml Mortar & Pestle sets (CH0540A, CH0541A and CH0541B). Mortar is not included
PORCELAIN || Pestle is made of solid porcelain. Grinding surface of the rounded end of the pestle is unglazed for precise grinding and crushing
HEAVY DUTY || The heavy duty porcelain construction is resistant to chips and cracks
3.85 INCH LENGTH || Pestle measures 3.85" in length, and the rounded grinding end measures 1" in diameter
reviews_5s: I liked that you cold feel the end of the pestle engage with the surface of the mortarJust the size, shape, color and material that I neededI bought this because I, too, dropped my porcelain pestle on a tile kitchen floor. As the picture shows, it's almost exactly the same size as the old one. Pro tip: the measurements of the pestle, both the diameter of the head and its length, are in the product description. It's easy to determine what size you need before you buy! I bought two, just in case, since I still have a tile floor. :-) it works just as well as the old one did.Perfect replacement for the grinder we brokeI cannot wait to use it. I had a handyman put it together, simple to light it up and it’s very pretty on my new deckPerfect size and glazed except for the bottom. Exactly what it says it is.
